name: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore

scam_info.sample: 2 June 2026 - Tax Penalty Scams IRAS has received reports on phishing emails with the subject headings “Official Notice of Tax Demand & Penalty” and “Tax Penalty – Under-declaration of Income”
scam_info.notes: Scam hub + 'Latest Scam Advisories' list: 9 dated items 3 Jan 2024 .. 2 Jun 2026 (2 Jun 2026 Tax Penalty Scams; 14 Nov 2025 Tax Refund Scams; 19 Mar 2025 Tax review email scam; 12 Dec 2024 Scam calls impersonating IRAS officers; 5 Apr 2024; 5 Mar 2024; 28 Feb 2024; 1 Feb 2024; 3 Jan 2024). Page 'last updated 24 August 2026'. Scam email subject lines quoted in text; fake emails/letters only as screenshot images (/images/default-source/scams-images/...). Legacy URL /news-events/announcements/advisory-on-scam-fraudulent-activities redirects here. No robots.txt (404) and no sitemap.xml (404); machine_url is the HTML sitemap page (821 links). No RSS; email 'IRAS eAlerts' subscription only (/subscribe-to-iras-ealerts).

scam_info.sample: Beware of phishing emails, letters, SMSes or chatbot messages spoofing IRAS’ identity and demanding you to file or pay taxes. Don’t fall for it!
scam_info.notes: Title 'Tax Filing and Payment Scam'; page last updated 17 November 2026. Gallery of screenshot captions naming scam-email subjects (e.g. '[Urgent] Tax Bill Discrepancy for YA 2025', 'Taxpayer Verification spoofed IRAS website scam'); indicators only inside images.

scam_info.sample: Always check the email address even though the sender ID shows ‘IRAS’ . Sender ID can be spoofed to make the email look legitimate. A legitimate email address from IRAS ends with “@iras.gov.sg”.
scam_info.notes: Tax Refund and Payout Scam. Gives official-channel facts: refunds only to registered bank account/PayNow, never to cards; IRAS emails end @iras.gov.sg. Screenshot captions of variants (Refund Notice, 'IRAS e-Refund: Identity Check Required').

scam_info.sample: If you are asked to pay a capital gains tax, income tax, Goods & Services Tax or Stamp Duty on your investment profits, beware. Do not pay!
scam_info.notes: Narrative; points to MAS Investor Alert List. Screenshots only.

scam_info.sample: Beware of requests to pay Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty (ABSD) or Stamp Duty to secure your rental property. Don’t fall for it!
scam_info.notes: Rental/property-agent scam; tells users to verify agents on CEA public register (eservices.cea.gov.sg). Anti-Scam Resource Guide sibling page only links scam-poster PDFs (/docs/default-source/tax-crime/scam-poster---english.pdf).

notes: official_domains iras.gov.sg (b). Official transaction host stated explicitly (a): 'transact safely on myTax Portal (mytax.iras.gov.sg)'; all notices deposited there; IRAS 'will not send correspondences with links to make payment'. Official payment modes: GIRO; internet banking / ATM bill payment / AXS selecting payee 'IRAS'; PayNow QR inside myTax Portal; stamp duty via GIRO, AXS, PayNow. SMS: 'Trust only gov.sg for SMS Sender ID ... SMS begins with the full name of the agency e.g. "Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore"'. go.gov.sg/iras-scam and go.gov.sg/iras-livechat used as short links. SPF brand tag 'Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS)' (5 advisories).
